mapper.select: SELECT V.SEC_ACCT_ID FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO V LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT R ON R.REGIST_ORG = V.REGIST_ORG WHERE PSA.ACCT_NO = V.SEC_ACCT_ID AND V.SEC_ACCT_TYPE = 'SEC' AND V.TRADE_PLACE = '01' AND PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND R.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT P.ACCT_NO FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO P LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO S ON P.ACCT_NO = S.ACCT_NO where P.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND P.ACCT_TYPE = #{acctType} and rownum=1
